game.name: Kinect Joy Ride (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Kinect Joy Ride on Xbox 360 is a crazy free car racing game where you can use your Xbox Live avatars to drive your own cars, which you can customize to your heart's content! The game is more multiplayer oriented, allowing you to play live and share content. The atmosphere is very cartoony, a la Roadrunner and Coyote, in settings inspired by the Grand Canyon.
